shortBio.en: Pink Floyd founder; guitar and vocals on Piper-era material before leaving in 1968.
shortBio.zh: Pink Floyd 创始人；《Piper》时期吉他与人声，1968 年离队。

body.en:
Born 1946, Cambridge. Names and leads early Pink Floyd. Writes and sings much of The Piper at the Gates of Dawn.

Leaves the band in 1968. Solo records follow. Dies 2006.
body.zh:
1946 年生于剑桥。命名并带领早期 Pink Floyd。《The Piper at the Gates of Dawn》大量写歌与主唱。

1968 年离队，后有个人唱片。2006 年去世。
